replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states 30-day session cookie; long-lived session reuse with no invalidation on contact change is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"CSRF on no-password profile update endpoint supported by quoted cookie session and immediate change evidence."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Email change without password re-entry enables session-hijack takeover; distinct from CSRF vector in T2."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"No email ownership verification; immediate effect quoted, harm of binding account to unverified mailbox is concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Lack of notification/audit of email change is a distinct repudiation issue tied to immediate-change design."}]}
